# apipbx_voicemail_box (Resource)

A voicemail box. Deleting it deletes its messages. Import with "<tenant id>/<box id>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `number` (String) 2-16 digits.
- `tenant_id` (String)

### Optional

- `attach` (Boolean) Attach the recording to the email.
- `delete_after_email` (Boolean)
- `email` (String) Notification addresses, separated by spaces or commas.
- `envelope` (Boolean)
- `language` (String) The language of the mailbox prompts (an Asterisk sound directory name such as en or es).
- `max_messages` (Number)
- `pin` (String, Sensitive) 3-10 digits; generated when omitted. Leave it out if the owner sets it from the phone.
- `say_cid` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
